text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Speed Symboli. Are you watching 
too?"

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
The future you entrusted to me— leads 
directly to the victory you envisioned.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
And that 'now' I can believe in is right 
here...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone's 'Representative Exchange 
Race' had concluded. At Mei Satake's call, 
the project participants lined up in 
formation.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Before I announce the representative 
members this time, there is something I 
want to discuss with all of you.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"You Japanese Umamusume have become 
remarkably strong."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: —I want you to be proud of that.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: I will now announce the lead-off runner. <chrname>!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the intrusion. Thank you for 
explaining things to the representatives. 
...Taking on the world once more, aren't 
we?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Symboli Rudolf, huh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
On behalf of the Symboli family, you have 
my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And as an Umamusume living in the present, 
I thank you for carrying on the history of 
taking on challenges.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Mencius' mother cutting the loom"... If 
our resolve had faltered along the way, we 
would never have been able to walk this 
path.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"The path Speed Symboli carved open is not 
filled with regret, but brimming with 
hope...!"

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: It is we who should be thanking you all.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Without someone to inherit them, those 
feelings will quickly fade away.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...We place our dreams upon you all.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Hello, Trainer <username>.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
You showed us some truly magnificent 
running in that Representative Exchange 
Race earlier.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...Time never turns back. Speed Symboli 
and the others' challenge can never be 
repeated again."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"Yet as long as there are those who carry 
on the torch, their challenge will not 
have been in vain."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"Speed Symboli's feelings, too, and old 
man Symboli's and old lady Mejiro's 
feelings as well."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
The feelings of all those who have 
challenged it in the past —are breathing 
right here inside you.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Can I believe that?
choice_data_list: I'd be honored if you felt that way.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Haha...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Mei! There... you are~!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...? What's wrong, Yayoi?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I got a call from Mother! She was just 
speaking with Speed Symboli—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"She's so strong, it's frustrating!" They 
all seemed to give her that exact seal of 
approval!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I see. To think Speed Symboli would 
finally show an emotion like 
"frustration"...!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: I wanted to win too, after all...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>. Let's head to the 'Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe.'

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: —Come on, let's go seize that dream.
